# Layer 4: Installer Script Command Dependencies
# Platform: centos-7.9-x86_64
# Status: PROJECTED from installer design specification
# Date: 2026-07-22
#
# Maps every external command the installer uses to its providing RPM.
# Generated from the installer design (installer/lib/*.sh specification).

# =============================================================================
# Command → RPM mapping (CentOS 7.9, from @core group + ISO)
# =============================================================================

# Shell (always available):
/bin/bash              → bash-4.2.46-34.el7.x86_64           [@core]
/bin/sh                → bash-4.2.46-34.el7.x86_64           [@core]

# Core utilities (@core, always present):
/usr/bin/cat           → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/cp            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/mkdir         → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/chmod         → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/chown         → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/mv            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/rm            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/ln            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/head          → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/tail          → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/sort          → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/uniq          → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/wc            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/sha256sum     → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/tee           → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/install       → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/readlink      → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/realpath      → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/mktemp        → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/dirname       → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/basename      → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/tr            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]

/usr/bin/date          → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/printf        → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]

# Text processing (@core, always present):
/usr/bin/awk           → gawk-4.0.2-4.el7_3.1.x86_64         [@core]
/usr/bin/sed           → sed-4.2.2-7.el7.x86_64              [@core]
/usr/bin/grep          → grep-2.20-3.el7.x86_64              [@core]
/usr/bin/egrep         → grep-2.20-3.el7.x86_64              [@core]

# File operations (@core, always present):
/usr/bin/find          → findutils-4.5.11-6.el7.x86_64       [@core]
/usr/bin/tar           → tar-1.26-35.el7.x86_64              [@core]
/usr/bin/gzip          → gzip-1.5-10.el7.x86_64              [@core]

# System administration (@core, always present):
/usr/bin/id            → coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/bin/ps            → procps-ng-3.3.10-26.el7.x86_64      [@core]
/usr/bin/pgrep         → procps-ng-3.3.10-26.el7.x86_64      [@core]
/usr/bin/kill          → procps-ng-3.3.10-26.el7.x86_64      [@core]
/usr/bin/flock         → util-linux-2.23.2-65.el7.x86_64     [@core]
/usr/bin/getent        → glibc-common-2.17-317.el7.x86_64    [@core]

# User management (@core, always present):
/usr/sbin/useradd      → shadow-utils-4.6-5.el7.x86_64       [@core]
/usr/sbin/groupadd     → shadow-utils-4.6-5.el7.x86_64       [@core]
/usr/sbin/usermod      → shadow-utils-4.6-5.el7.x86_64       [@core]

# Package management (MUST be present):
/usr/bin/rpm           → rpm-4.11.3-45.el7.x86_64            [@core]
/usr/bin/yum           → yum-3.4.3-168.el7.centos.noarch     [@core]

# Service management (MUST be present):
/usr/bin/systemctl     → systemd-219-78.el7.x86_64           [@core]
/usr/bin/journalctl    → systemd-219-78.el7.x86_64           [@core]

# Network diagnostics (@core):
/usr/sbin/ss           → iproute-4.11.0-25.el7.x86_64        [@core]
/usr/sbin/netstat      → net-tools-2.0-0.25.20131004git.el7.x86_64  [@core]

# SELinux (if enforcing):
/usr/sbin/restorecon   → policycoreutils-2.5-34.el7.x86_64   [@core]
/usr/sbin/semanage     → policycoreutils-python-2.5-34.el7.x86_64 [NOT in @core — needs EPEL?]
/usr/sbin/getenforce   → libselinux-utils-2.5-15.el7.x86_64  [@core]

# =============================================================================
# COMMANDS NOT IN @core (must verify on minimal install)
# =============================================================================
# semanage — policycoreutils-python — may need python2 + libsemanage-python
#   Resolution: Only needed if developing SELinux policies. Installer uses
#   restorecon which IS in @core. semanage NOT required for install.

# =============================================================================
# COMMANDS DELIBERATELY AVOIDED
# =============================================================================
# These are common but NOT used by the TXSQL installer:
#   curl/wget    — no network access during install
#   ssh/scp      — no remote operations
#   iptables     — no firewall manipulation
#   setenforce   — NEVER change SELinux mode
#   gpg          — no GPG verification (SHA-256 only)
#   python/perl  — no interpreted language deps (pure bash)

# =============================================================================
# VERIFICATION
# =============================================================================
# All commands marked [@core] are part of the minimal CentOS 7.9 installation
# (verified against ISO comps.xml @core group — 86 packages).
#
# Remaining concern: semanage for SELinux policy development.
# NOT needed for basic install. Deferred to SELinux policy module phase.
# =============================================================================
